title: The Drowned Street
journal: Nesh-Deeka sent me with the keystone to the Chime-Keepers of Toklea, who keep what is left of Kothringi lore. I'm to show it to their elder in the Kothringi Greathouse.
objectives: Show the keystone to the elder of the Chime-Keepers in Toklea. (marker: Hums-the-Long-Note)

plan.going: The keystone from the wreck is Kothringi; the Chime-Keepers' elder may know what it opens.
plan.next: Take boats to Lujei Ferry, cross to Toklea and show the keystone to the elder in the Kothringi Greathouse.

answers: I work for Nesh-Deeka of the Toh-Reel-Ka in Helstrom. I took a Kothringi Keystone from the Pale Harvest wreck. The Collector (Ennodius Vanin) and the Unbound are hunting the Eye, and the keystone seems tied to it.
Go to the Kothringi Greathouse in Toklea and show the keystone to the elder of the Chime-Keepers, Hums-the-Long-Note.
I can talk to the elder and show the keystone, ask about Kothringi lore, the Eye, and the Collector. Fighting is possible if it turns hostile.
I do not understand what the Eye is or what the keystone does. I could find out by asking the elder.

title: The Drowned Street
journal: Hums-the-Long-Note knows the keystone, and named her price: her family's carved grave-stake lies in a chest in the drowned street of Zul-Etha, and she wants it raised. Crocodiles lie on the roof peaks above it. I may kill them from a roof or from range, calm them with Illusion, or swim under them unseen to the chest.
objectives: Raise the grave-stake from the chest in Zul-Etha's drowned street. (marker: Drowned Chest)

plan.going: The elder will say what the keystone opens if I raise her family's grave-stake.
plan.next: Go to Zul-Etha and take the grave-stake from the chest under the water.
plan.ways: Kill the crocodiles (from a roof or from range), calm them with Illusion, or swim under them unseen.
terms: Zul-Etha: Hums-the-Long-Note: a carting village the washes drowned, south-east of Mir-Xal

answers: Hums-the-Long-Note knows the keystone but wants payment first: her family grave-stake from a chest in drowned Zul-Etha.
Go to Zul-Etha (south-east of Mir-Xal quay) and raise the stake from the Drowned Chest, then bring it back.
Kill the crocodiles and old bull from a roof or with arrows (fighting suits me), calm them with Illusion, or swim under them unseen.
I do not know what the keystone is or what the Eye is; Hums will tell after the stake. Zul-Etha and Mir-Xal I can reach by travelling to the marker.

title: The Drowned Street
journal: I raised the grave-stake from the drowned street. I'm to bring it to Hums-the-Long-Note in the Kothringi Greathouse in Toklea.
objectives: Bring the grave-stake to Hums-the-Long-Note in Toklea. (marker: Hums-the-Long-Note)

plan.going: I have the stake; the elder owes me the keystone's story.

answers: I killed the crocodiles in Zul-Etha and took the Carved Grave-Stake, Hums-the-Long-Note price for telling me about the keystone.
Bring it to Hums in the Kothringi Greathouse, Toklea.
Just deliver it and then ask about the keystone; no other route shown.
Still do not know what the keystone or the Eye is; Hums should tell.

title: The Drowned Street
journal: Hums-the-Long-Note took her family's stake and kept her word: the keystone opens the tomb of the knight-captain at Eurydike, a ruin near Gideon. The Kothringi knights of Gideon were the last to guard the kings' road to the Root. I'm to tell Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom.
objectives: Tell Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom what the keystone opens. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: The keystone opens the knight-captain's tomb at Eurydike, on the old road to the Root.
terms: Eurydike and the knights of Gideon: Hums-the-Long-Note: the hall of Kothringi knights who served in Gideon's garrison and guarded the kings' road to the Root

answers: Hums took the stake and told me the keystone opens the tomb of the Kothringi knight-captain at Eurydike near Gideon; the knights guarded the kings road to the Root.
Report to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom.
Report now, or go to Eurydike myself; the journal asks me to report.
I do not know what the Root is, or the Eye, or where Gideon is exactly; Nesh-Deeka or the tomb may tell.

title: The Drowned Street
journal: Nesh-Deeka heard me out. She already knew that the Unbound have been asking Gideon's diggers about Eurydike. Before I could ask how, she said "we listen" and told me to hurry. She paid me 100 gold.

plan.going: The Unbound are close behind on the same trail; Nesh-Deeka knows it and will not say how.
plan.next: MN09 starts; its first entry marks Eurydike.

answers: Quest done: the keystone opens the knight-captain tomb at Eurydike near Gideon, a step toward the Eye of Argonia at the Root. Nesh-Deeka paid 100 gold and says hurry because the Unbound are asking Gideon diggers about Eurydike.
Nothing is set by the journal; logically go to Eurydike near Gideon with the keystone.
Go to Eurydike and open the tomb, expecting the Unbound; fight if needed.
I do not understand how Nesh-Deeka knows what she knows (she says we listen), nor what the Root or the Eye truly is.
